column1: # legend_over_target.tsv — clauses allowed to take a legend PAST its stair-step target (PROCESS rule 5; test/lib/legendtarget.sh).
# One row per clause: which content, why the answer needs it. A row explains an excess only on an answer where the clause RIDES
# (its marker, a verbatim substring of the clause, is in the legend) AND is present-only there (its attr token is rendered in the
# payload). The registered bytes must cover the whole excess. Re-pinning the target down to the measured value stays a one-line edit
# in the gate; a row here is for content a complete answer needs that the old number did not foresee.
# Columns (tab-separated): surface  clause  bytes  attr  marker  reason
#   surface  ripwire.<key>/v1 (compactlegendcheck (U)), loop, mcp:<verb>, mcp:edit_check:answer, full:<shape> (the full-dialect gates)
